alt: TracFone confirmed the Moto G Play 2024 (IMEI ending 3198) is permanently Network Unlocked but stated they lack the technical ability to rewrite factory-level secure-boot partition blocks and referred to their terms of service regarding unauthorized product use.
summary: TracFone confirmed the Moto G Play 2024 (IMEI ending 3198) is permanently Network Unlocked but stated they lack the technical ability to rewrite factory-level secure-boot partition blocks and referred to their terms of service regarding unauthorized product use.
full_text: TracFone confirms the Moto G Play 2024 (IMEI ending 3198) is permanently Network Unlocked. However, regarding firmware restrictions, they state that as a distributor of retail hardware using OEM carrier profiles, they lack the source code or technical mechanisms to rewrite factory-level secure-boot partition blocks. They direct the consumer to their terms of service regarding unauthorized use of products.
